name: costa-rica-social-contributions
description: Use this skill for Costa Rica employer and employee social charges (cargas sociales) in 2026. It gives the CCSS table in force from January 2026, health and maternity (SEM) 9.25% employer and 5.50% worker, pensions (IVM) 5.58% employer and 4.33% worker after the January 2026 increase to 11.66% in total, the employer's other institutions (Asignaciones Familiares 5%, IMAS 0.5%, INA 1.5%, Banco Popular 0.25%) and the Ley de Proteccion al Trabajador charges (Banco Popular 0.25% employer and 1% worker, FCL 1.5%, OPC 2%, INS 1%), totals 26.83% employer and 10.83% worker, the minimum contributory bases (CRC 346,789 SEM, CRC 324,590 IVM), the planilla calendar and the 2% surcharges. Trigger phrases include cargas sociales 2026, CCSS planilla, SEM IVM, Ley de Proteccion al Trabajador and BMC.
